detail.empty_issues_hint: You can also add existing issues to this project.

resources.local_daemon_offline_hint: Start the local daemon to attach a directory on this machine.
resources.local_no_daemon_tooltip: Local daemon isn't reporting an ID yet — the agent can't open this directory.
resources.local_other_machine_tooltip: Only available on the machine that registered this directory.
resources.chat_hint_worktree_prefix: Agent will work in an isolated worktree of
resources.chat_hint_worktree_note: Your working copy stays untouched — each run hands its work back as an agent/… branch.
resources.chat_hint_shared_prefix: Agent will work concurrently in the shared workspace
resources.chat_hint_shared_note: Isolate branches yourself via per-repo worktrees. Multica will not lock this directory.
resources.toast_local_already_attached: This directory is already attached to the project on this machine.
resources.local_validate_unsupported: Local directories can only be picked on the desktop app.
resources.mode_dialog_title: How should runs use this folder?
resources.mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether runs on this folder can execute at the same time.
resources.mode_in_place_description: One run at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
resources.mode_worktree_description: Runs execute at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, keep editing the folder directly, or use shared workspace mode if tasks isolate themselves via per-repo worktrees.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Multica server is too old to execute runs in parallel — it would quietly execute them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
resources.mode_shared_description: Runs execute at the same time in this folder. Isolate each task with your own per-repo worktrees — Multica will not lock the directory or write its files into it.
resources.mode_shared_needs_server_upgrade: Your Multica server is too old to honour shared workspace mode — it would quietly lock this folder and run one task at a time. Update the server, then switch this on.
resources.mode_shared_uses_local_override: This server does not store shared mode. Multica will save the folder as in-place and skip the directory lock on this machine, so runs can still start together.
resources.toast_local_shared_via_daemon: Official cloud does not accept shared mode. This folder will run in parallel on this machine without a directory lock.
resources.mode_shared_rejected_by_server: Official cloud does not accept the shared mode enum. Switched to local lock-free parallel instead.
resources.mode_edit_tooltip: Change how runs use this folder
resources.mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Runs execute at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
resources.mode_badge_shared_tooltip: Runs execute at the same time in this folder. Tasks isolate themselves via per-repo worktrees; Multica does not lock the directory.
resources.toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode
resources.duplicate_body: A local directory and {{remotes}} remote repository entry point at the same repository. Tasks on that machine use the local directory, so the remote entries only cause a second copy to be downloaded.
resources.mode_worktree_cost: Costs disk on YOUR drive: a full working copy per task, created under {{path}}. You can open them, and Multica never deletes one that still has uncommitted changes.
resources.mode_worktree_cost_unknown_path: Costs disk on YOUR drive: a full working copy per task, created in a folder next to this repository. You can open them, and Multica never deletes one that still has uncommitted changes.
resources.local_directory_default_hint: Tasks on this machine run in the first directory in this list. Use the arrows to reorder; the others stay available read-only.
resources.mode_worktree_root_not_absolute: Use an absolute path — a relative one would land wherever the daemon happens to be running.
resources.mode_worktree_root_inside_repo: This is inside the repository. Copies there would show up in your own git status and need a .gitignore entry — pick a folder beside it instead.
resources.mode_worktree_root_not_writable: This folder is not writable. Pick a location this machine can create files in.
resources.mode_worktree_root_conflicts: This overlaps a directory already bound to the project. Pick a different folder.
resources.local_daemon_already_attached_hint: This machine already has a local directory attached. Remove it before adding another.
resources.toast_local_daemon_already_attached: This machine already has a local directory attached to this project. Remove it before adding another.

delete_dialog.title: Delete project
delete_dialog.description: This will delete the project. Issues will not be deleted but will be unlinked.
